subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: What scope should own this browser/search hardening task: a security-reviewed browser backend design, narrower web/search reliability bugs, or a benchmark/evaluation-only research track?
rationale: The evidence shows missing capability and overlapping open work, but choosing Lightpanda/external browser support and browser-backed search semantics changes security and product boundaries.

options.title: Split into scoped tracks
options.body: Keep this open as an umbrella until maintainers split approved search fixes, browser backend/Lightpanda design, and benchmark criteria into separately reviewable work.

options.title: Route to existing browser issues
options.body: Move Lightpanda and browser-backed access discussion to the existing open browser issues, then leave only a narrow search benchmark or SearXNG bug here.

options.title: Keep current tool split
options.body: Define web_search and web_fetch as non-browser provider tools and handle alternate browser experiments outside core until a concrete missing extension API is identified.

recommendation.title: Split into scoped tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this open as an umbrella until maintainers split approved search fixes, browser backend/Lightpanda design, and benchmark criteria into separately reviewable work.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue crosses security defaults, browser boundaries, and search-provider behavior, and the sampled history points most strongly to steipete for product/security routing.
